reason: Both propose essentially the same localized fusion-based IN718 transition-layer repair and share a major physical weakness: IN718 is not credible for sustained service across the stated upper range of 1000–1200 °C, while laser cladding can itself produce segregation and hot cracking. A has more directly relevant transition-layer evidence but largely restates that prior approach; B is somewhat more quantitative but its 15% criterion is arbitrary and its cited evidence does not support the proposed transition-layer mechanism.
